selection: Decoder only, no writer/CLI/runtime dependencies. Private relocation keeps existing x/image v0.24.0 unchanged instead of upgrading shared codecs for this single plugin. Local changes add Pillow I/F scalar samples and route JPEG blocks through existing Pillow-compatible JPEG port.
license: BSD3, retained LICENSE and original file headers
local_adaptations: I/F scalar decoding and original float/integer predictors
JPEG strips use existing Pillow-compatible JPEG port
Expose native Orientation tag; parent applies ImageOps.exif_transpose semantics
BigTIFF first-IFD normalization happens in the parent decoder
Packed grayscale and palette samples follow the Pillow raw unpacker table in https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/12.2.0/src/libImaging/Unpack.c
Separate RGB/RGBA strips and tiles undo the predictor per band and then assemble one pixel block. Raw 16-bit planar TIFF retains the byte-oriented channel reads in TiffImagePlugin._setup.
